verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: independently reconcile identity, acquisition route, mechanics, CaC availability, and unresolved costs without promoting unsupported claims.
research_scope: Super Dragon Fist — Strike Super acquisition and mechanics research.

verification_audit.method: Compared repository research coverage with current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation and independent acquisition reports.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Super Dragon Fist was found. Dragon Fist is a separate Strike Ultimate and is not treated as the same identity.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation classifies Super Dragon Fist as a Strike Super.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation lists Skill Shop as the acquisition route. Independent player reports also place it in the regular Skill Shop after early story progression; exact shop timing is not promoted to canonical data.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required is null because the documented acquisition route is the Skill Shop rather than a Parallel Quest reward.
verification_audit.cost_policy: The documented Ki cost is 100; stamina cost remains null because the reviewed sources do not establish a reliable stamina value.

records.name: Super Dragon Fist
records.character_source: Goku / Goku (Super Saiyan God) / Goku (GT) Customize Partner / Goku (Super Saiyan 4) / other documented customizable partners
records.skill_description: A short-range-to-rushdown Strike Super in which the user flies toward the opponent and, on connection, performs a rapid three-hit punch sequence.
records.mechanics_notes: The current Xenoverse 2 skill reference describes a short approach followed by three rapid punches on hit. Exact frame and damage values are not promoted to canonical data here.
records.acquisition_notes: Skill Shop is the documented Xenoverse 2 route. Independent reports also describe the move appearing in the regular Skill Shop after early story progression; exact timing is not encoded as a fixed unlock flag.
records.pve_notes: Skill Shop acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Fast approach and three-hit rushdown behavior are documented; detailed matchup and frame claims remain version-sensitive.
